entries.title: Change Max Send on a route
steps: Open the origin building's destinations panel in the game.
On the route, use the Max Send arrows (infinity = unlimited).
Remember the value is shared by every origin shipping this product to that destination.

evidence.note: user set Max Send in the route UI; arrows wrap to infinity

entries.caveats: This MCP is read-only and cannot change it for you.
entries.title_fr: Modifier Max Send sur une route

entries.title: Change Min Keep on a route
steps: Open the origin building's destinations panel.
On the route, use the Min Keep arrows (0..99; past the ends: keep all).

evidence.note: user changed Min Keep in the route UI

entries.caveats: This MCP is read-only and cannot change it for you.
entries.title_fr: Modifier Min Keep sur une route

entries.title: Change a building's efficiency
steps: Select the building in the game and use its efficiency slider.
Higher levels may need a technology unlock.

evidence.note: efficiency slider; higher indices gated by unlocks

entries.caveats: The exact UI location is not recorded in the repository. This MCP cannot change it.

entries.title: Find the best shop for a product
steps: Call find_shops(product, from_building=<your producer>) sorted by unmet_demand or price.
Existing routes show the game's distance and dispatch cost; others show a non-authoritative straight-line estimate.
Use find_opportunities(types=['route_surplus']) to see where spare supply could go.
entries.title_fr: Trouver le meilleur magasin pour un produit

entries.title: Find out why a product is not produced enough
steps: Call diagnose_chain(product) for ranked findings with evidence.
Inspect a building with get_building(include=['production','inventory','incoming_routes']).
Check routes with review_routes(product=...).
entries.title_fr: Comprendre pourquoi un produit est trop peu produit

entries.title: Plan buildings for a production target
steps: Call plan_chain(product, target_per_month).
Compare variants with what_if(change={type:'add_buildings', ...}).
Read assumptions and confidence before deciding.
entries.title_fr: Planifier les bâtiments pour un objectif de production

entries.title: Check which products make money
steps: Call get_profitability() for the game's own product statistics and the advisor's unit-cost estimate.
Use get_finances(months=6) for the monthly ledger by category.

entries.title: See what changed recently
steps: Call what_changed(); pass since_seq=<meta.snapshot.seq from an earlier answer> to compare with that snapshot.
The monthly part compares the last two complete months from game-retained history.
entries.caveats: Only snapshots this server loaded while answering calls (last 20 / 30 minutes, current world session) are compared.
entries.title_fr: Voir ce qui a changé récemment

entries.title: Get fresh data
steps: Pass fresh=true to a tool; it waits up to 3 s for a new snapshot.
Always check meta.stale and meta.warnings.

entries.title: Check that the MCP sees the game
steps: Call get_game_status(): game state, observer captures, compatibility.
entries.title_fr: Vérifier que le MCP voit le jeu
